products.name: Star Gold Gr
products.shortDescription: Biological granule developed from seaweed and plant extracts for optimal crop nutrition and yield enhancement.
products.description: Star Gold Gr is a premium biological granule developed from seaweed and plant extracts based on advanced biological technology. It contains humic acids, amino acids, enzymes and plant growth stimulants required for optimal nutrition of the crop. This scientifically formulated product enhances root development, nutrient absorption and overall plant vitality.
benefits: Seedlings settle quickly due to vigorous growth of crop roots.
Improves absorption of main and micronutrients from the soil by the roots and their distribution throughout the plant, increasing efficiency of given nutrients.
Increases photosynthetic activity by increasing the production of chlorophyll in the leaves.
Reduces the total duration of the crop and reduces the cost of production.
Increases crop yield, commodity quality and soil fertility.
Crops develop immunity and avoid crop damage due to climate change.
Significantly increases the number of flowers in the crop; less flowering increases overall fruits.

composition.ingredient: Seaweed extract (Ascophyllum nodosum), % by weight, maximum
Protein hydrolysates derived from defatted soya flour by enzymatic (papain) hydrolysis, % by weight, minimum
Humic acid (source: Leonardite) per ent. by weight, minimum

specifications.parameter: Free amino acids %, by weight, minimum
Total amino acids %, by weight, minimum
Total dissolved solids %, by weight, minimum
Total organic carbon %, by weight, minimum

methods: Dosage: 10 kg per acre. Can be mixed with any chemical fertilizer and applied together.
Alternative: Can be used in a different application form as directed by an agronomist.
Apply at the time of basal or top dressing fertilizer application for best results.

products.storage: Granular organic granules can be stored for up to three years from the date of production. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Not toxic at all. Completely safe for humans, animals, and the environment.

safety.title: Eco-Safe
safety.text: Formulated with natural biological ingredients. No harmful chemical residues.

safety.title: Child Safety
safety.text: Keep out of reach of children. Store in original packaging.

products.name: Bio Root Plus
products.shortDescription: Advanced biological root stimulant for rapid establishment and strong root architecture in all crops.
products.description: Bio Root Plus is a concentrated biological liquid formulation combining plant growth promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR), humic acid and seaweed extracts. Designed to accelerate root elongation, improve soil microbiome and enhance crop establishment under stress conditions.
benefits: Accelerates root elongation and lateral root formation within 5–7 days of application.
Improves soil microbial activity creating a healthy rhizosphere.
Enhances water and nutrient uptake efficiency.
Increases transplant success rate and reduces transplant shock.
Compatible with drip irrigation systems.
Improves tolerance to drought and salinity stress.

composition.ingredient: Plant Growth Promoting Rhizobacteria (PGPR), CFU/ml minimum

methods: Soil drench: Dilute 2–3 ml per litre of water and apply at the root zone.
Drip irrigation: 1–2 litres per acre through drip system.
Seed treatment: Mix 5 ml per kg of seed before sowing.

products.storage: Store in cool and dry place below 30°C. Shelf life: 2 years from date of manufacture.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Contains only biological organisms; completely safe for humans and the environment.

safety.title: Eco-Safe
safety.text: Promotes beneficial soil biology; no adverse environmental effects.

products.name: Humic Power
products.shortDescription: High-concentration humic and fulvic acid soil conditioner to improve soil structure, CEC and nutrient availability.
products.description: Humic Power is a powerful concentrated extract of humic and fulvic acids derived from premium grade Leonardite. It works as a natural soil conditioner that improves cation exchange capacity (CEC), soil aeration and the bioavailability of macro and micronutrients.
benefits: Significantly improves cation exchange capacity (CEC) of soil.
Chelates micronutrients making them available to plant roots.
Improves soil structure and water retention capacity.
Enhances beneficial microbial activity.
Reduces soil compaction and improves aeration.
Increases fertilizer use efficiency by 20–30%.

composition.ingredient: Humic acid (Leonardite source), % by weight, minimum

methods: Soil application: 4–8 kg per acre mixed with fertilizer at basal dose.
Fertigation: 2–4 kg per acre through drip/sprinkler irrigation.
Foliar: 1–2 g per litre of water as foliar spray.

products.storage: Store in a cool, dry place in a sealed container. Shelf life 3 years.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Derived from natural Leonardite; safe for humans, animals and soil organisms.

safety.title: Environment Safe
safety.text: Improves soil health; no chemical contamination.

products.name: Amino Boost
products.shortDescription: Enzymatically hydrolyzed protein amino acid concentrate for rapid plant uptake and stress recovery.
products.description: Amino Boost is a concentrated liquid formulation of free amino acids obtained through enzymatic hydrolysis of plant-based proteins. It provides plants with readily absorbable amino acids, supporting protein synthesis, enzyme activity and resistance to biotic and abiotic stress.
benefits: Provides chelated amino acids directly available for plant metabolism.
Supports rapid recovery from stress conditions like drought, frost or pest attack.
Improves photosynthesis and chlorophyll content.
Increases flower set and reduces flower/fruit drop.
Enhances protein synthesis and enzyme activity in plants.
Improves quality parameters: size, colour, sugar content, shelf life.

composition.ingredient: Total amino acids, % by weight, minimum
Free amino acids, % by weight, minimum

methods: Foliar spray: 2–3 ml per litre of water every 10–15 days.
Fertigation: 1–2 litres per acre through drip irrigation.
During stress: Apply immediately after stress event at 3–4 ml/litre.

products.storage: Store in cool dry place away from sunlight. Do not freeze. Shelf life 2 years.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Plant-based protein source; completely non-toxic and bio-safe.

safety.title: Environment Safe
safety.text: Biodegradable; no environmental hazard.

products.name: Sea Zyme
products.shortDescription: Pure seaweed extract concentrate rich in cytokinins, auxins, alginic acid and natural growth hormones.
products.description: Sea Zyme is a premium cold-processed seaweed extract derived from Ascophyllum nodosum. It is a rich natural source of cytokinins, auxins, betaines, mannitol, alginic acid, vitamins and trace elements that stimulate plant growth, improve stress tolerance and enhance soil biological activity.
benefits: Stimulates cell division and elongation through natural cytokinin activity.
Improves germination rate and seedling vigour.
Enhances flowering, fruit set and reduces premature fruit drop.
Improves tolerance to temperature stress, drought and salinity.
Activates soil microbial populations.
Improves colour, size and shelf life of fruits and vegetables.

composition.ingredient: Seaweed extract (Ascophyllum nodosum), % by weight, minimum

methods: Foliar spray: 2–3 ml per litre of water; apply at critical growth stages.
Drip irrigation: 1–2 litres per acre.
Seed priming: Soak seeds in 3 ml/litre solution for 4–6 hours before sowing.

products.storage: Store in cool dry place below 25°C. Shelf life 2 years from manufacture.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: 100% natural seaweed origin; safe for all users and the environment.

safety.title: Residue Free
safety.text: No chemical residues; suitable for organic farming systems.

products.name: Bio Zyme Plus
products.shortDescription: Multi-enzyme biological stimulant to accelerate nutrient cycling and boost crop metabolism.
products.description: Bio Zyme Plus is a complex of plant-derived enzymes including protease, cellulase, amylase and lipase formulated to accelerate organic matter decomposition, mobilize soil-locked nutrients and boost plant metabolic processes.
benefits: Accelerates decomposition of crop residues and organic matter.
Mobilizes phosphorus, potassium and micronutrients locked in soil.
Enhances plant metabolic rate and energy production.
Improves soil biological activity and organic matter content.
Compatible with most fertilizers and pesticides.
Reduces need for chemical inputs over time.

methods: Soil application: 1–2 litres per acre through drip or flood irrigation.
Foliar spray: 2 ml per litre of water at vegetative and reproductive stages.

products.storage: Store in cool dry place below 30°C away from direct sunlight. Shelf life 2 years.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Plant-derived enzymes; non-toxic to humans, animals and beneficial organisms.

safety.title: Biodegradable
safety.text: Fully biodegradable; no environmental persistence.

products.name: Nitro Fix
products.shortDescription: Nitrogen-fixing biofertilizer containing Azotobacter and Rhizobium for natural atmospheric nitrogen fixation.
products.description: Nitro Fix is a biofertilizer containing a consortium of nitrogen-fixing bacteria including Azotobacter chroococcum and Rhizobium species. It reduces dependency on synthetic nitrogen fertilizers by fixing atmospheric nitrogen and making it available to crops.
benefits: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen (N2) converting it to plant-available ammonium.
Reduces chemical nitrogen fertilizer requirement by 20–25%.
Produces phytohormones promoting root and shoot growth.
Improves soil health and long-term fertility.
Suitable for all crops including legumes, cereals and vegetables.
Completely safe for the environment and soil ecosystem.

methods: Seed treatment: Mix 200 g per kg of seed; dry in shade before sowing.
Soil application: 2 kg per acre mixed with 50 kg organic manure.
Seedling dip: Prepare slurry of 200 g in 2 litres water; dip roots for 15 minutes before transplanting.

products.storage: Store in cool dry place below 25°C away from sunlight and chemicals. Shelf life 2 years.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Contains only naturally occurring soil bacteria; completely safe.

safety.title: Eco-Friendly
safety.text: Promotes natural nitrogen cycle; reduces chemical pollution.

products.name: Phospho Rich
products.shortDescription: Phosphate solubilizing biofertilizer to unlock fixed soil phosphorus and improve P availability.
products.description: Phospho Rich contains highly effective phosphate solubilizing bacteria (PSB) including Bacillus megaterium and Pseudomonas fluorescens that solubilize fixed inorganic phosphates and mineralise organic phosphorus, making phosphorus readily available to plants.
benefits: Solubilizes fixed soil phosphate and makes it plant available.
Produces organic acids that lower rhizosphere pH and mobilize locked nutrients.
Reduces requirement for chemical phosphatic fertilizers by 25%.
Produces plant growth hormones (IAA, gibberellin).
Improves root biomass and overall plant growth.
Enhances soil microbial diversity.

methods: Seed treatment: 200 g per kg seed; allow to dry in shade before sowing.
Soil application: 2–4 kg per acre mixed with compost/FYM.
Drip irrigation: 500 g dissolved in 10 litres of water per acre.

products.storage: Store at cool temperature below 25°C away from direct sunlight. Shelf life 2 years.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Natural soil bacteria; safe for humans, animals and soil ecosystem.

safety.title: Eco-Friendly
safety.text: Reduces phosphorus pollution from chemical fertilizer run-off.

products.name: Myco Root
products.shortDescription: Arbuscular Mycorrhizal Fungi (AMF) inoculant for enhanced nutrient and water absorption through extended root network.
products.description: Myco Root is a carefully produced inoculant of Arbuscular Mycorrhizal Fungi (AMF) including Glomus intraradices and Glomus mosseae. It establishes a symbiotic relationship with plant roots, extending effective root area by up to 700% and dramatically improving phosphorus, zinc, copper and water uptake.
benefits: Extends root absorption area by up to 700% through hyphal network.
Improves uptake of phosphorus, zinc, copper, iron and water.
Significantly improves drought tolerance and water use efficiency.
Reduces phosphatic fertilizer requirement by 30–40%.
Improves plant establishment in poor or degraded soils.
Long-lasting effect; colonies persist for the entire crop cycle and beyond.

methods: Seed treatment: Apply 50–100 g per kg of seed.
Seedling treatment: Dip roots in slurry (100 g in 500 ml water) before transplanting.
Soil application: 2 kg per acre placed near root zone during sowing/planting.

products.storage: Store in cool dark place at 4–10°C. Do not freeze. Shelf life 18 months.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Natural fungi naturally present in soils; completely safe.

safety.title: Eco-Friendly
safety.text: Promotes sustainable agriculture and soil health.

products.name: Potash Bio
products.shortDescription: Potassium mobilizing biofertilizer to unlock soil-fixed potassium and improve crop quality.
products.description: Potash Bio is a biofertilizer containing Frateuria aurantia bacteria known for their ability to mobilize fixed potassium from soil minerals. It improves potassium availability for crop uptake, directly improving fruit quality, yield and disease resistance.
benefits: Mobilizes soil-fixed potassium from silicate minerals.
Reduces chemical potassic fertilizer requirement by 20%.
Improves fruit quality parameters: colour, taste, size and shelf life.
Strengthens cell walls improving resistance to diseases.
Improves sugar content in fruits and commercial crops.
Reduces lodging in cereal crops.

methods: Seed treatment: 200 g per kg seed.
Soil application: 2–4 kg per acre mixed with FYM.
Fertigation: 500 g dissolved in water per acre.

products.storage: Store at 15–25°C in sealed packaging away from sunlight. Shelf life 2 years.

safety.title: Non-Toxic
safety.text: Natural bacteria; safe for all users and the environment.

safety.title: Eco-Friendly
safety.text: Reduces chemical potassium fertilizer use and associated pollution.
